scope: User approved independent AP3P confirmation after frozen scheme; preserve Stage7B acceptance edits; no commit/push/main/next stage
development: No Stage7C development tuning; Stage7B is historical selection evidence; candidate, preprocessing, gates, methods and scenes fixed before new input retrieval

dtu.calibration: Existing official SampleSet cal18 matrices, same acquisition positions, new object IDs do not imply new camera trajectory

tum.selection: First7 RGB regular-file members in official TAR archive order, sort chosen filenames. normal/blur first5, reduced first3, spaced indices0/3/6. No quality/GT/overlap reselection. Archive-order subsets need not be temporally adjacent; all access failures retained, no substitute scenes.
tum.reference: Official mocap optical-center camera-to-world xyzw; nearest within20ms then invert; missing reference recorded unknown

preprocessing: Exact Stage7B family-specific profile: DTU1600x1200->800x600 Pillow bilinear, K pixel-center affine; TUM640x480 same-K OpenCV undistortion with black borders, no crop. Blur radius4 original pixels BEFORE resize/undistort. No new model or weights.
frozen_geometry: MSAC1.5 uniform/LO12/20/10000, same H/decomposition/DLT/gates; original PnP1000/.999/2px/12inliers. AP3P changes only minimal PnP RANSAC solver. BA20evaluations/5seconds, no points/observations subsampling or new retries. Both rankings independently predeclared, no post-test winner selection.
metrics: Same failure-aware allplannedpair linear joint pose scores5/10/20, complete accurate<=5deg, registered/correct cameras, initialization, false>5/severe>20, per-scene/seed/condition tails and costs. Scenes equally weighted within family; conditions/seeds correlated, not independent sample count. Primary C and secondary B never pooled. Unknown references/unrun rows separate, no evidence claim unless full planned matrix available.

gates.general: For EACH ranking, primary C: DTU AND TUM macro score10>=legacy, complete accurate nondecrease, false/severe counts nonincrease, no scene severe increase, all data/GT and technical audits complete. No tolerance picked to fit Stage7B DTU drop.
gates.tum_replication: For EACH ranking: TUM score10 increase>=.01 OR >=10% fewer false with nondecreasing score; >=4/5 seed macro score deltas positive; all3 TUM scenes score nonnegative. Also general nonregression gates above.
gates.decision: If TUM gate passes but DTU gate fails, only conditional cross-scene TUM evidence, NO global replacement. If gates fail do not tune/reselect scenes or add methods. Any B severe increase rules out frontend-independent safety. Even all gates pass only bounded six-scene confirmation, no auto-default or novelty claim.
gates.technical: Source/input hashes/GT guard/scene split verified; shared seeds and before-BA seed poses identical between solvers; all960 planned runs and pair slots accounted for, no process errors/missing references/BA walltimeouts; retain all geometric failures and budget-limited BA. Candidate selection lock precedes first new downloads and predictions.

stop: One fixed960-map matrix only. No extra thresholds/weights/LM/source replacement, training, fusion, new optimization, unseen data expansion or next stage. Access failures remain planned unavailable and cannot be counted as passed. Stop at budget; large/full archives forbidden. Preserve all historical and current failures. No commit/push without separate confirmation.
independence_scope: New DTU OBJECTS and TUM RECORDINGS, not guaranteed new geography; fr1_desk2/room may share office with previous desk. Sequence-level held-out replication only; cannot claim location-independent TUM generalization.
final_freeze_note: All protocol/source fields finalized before first new scene retrieval; five synthetic acceptance-gate tests passed, no held-out outcome inspected.
